Complete revised primary and every in-file alternative reread by editor_late; compared with complete source from verified snapshot. Distinct incidents, emotional destination, historical household/voice and known contradictions checked; local transition repetitions repaired on the second pass. This is editorial review, not owner approval or illustration clearance.
Independent reviewer opened all three current sheets at native resolution, originals and native detail crops; no material findings. Qualitative scale and grooming states remain provisional.

Buddy four owned feet under elongated trunk and raised speaking muzzle; Neet seated haunch support and compact forepaws coherent. Little green-ring speaker is ordinary object, one existing ball in basket; no invented robot body or multiplied balls.
Final must remove Buddy long sawtooth foreleg-back/underside fringe and keep Neet throat close; preserve Buddy regional face/ear furnishings.
Every current finished image opened at full resolution against original photos; concrete findings recorded per image.

The opening snack-genie expectation gains a quiet physical payoff when Buddy waits for the speaker to open. Neet declaring data-driven serenity immediately before lunging at the squirrel gives a clear setup/reversal without sacrificing his voice.

Buddy has sustained agency: reward volunteering, extra paw, alarm flood, extravagant ball request and attempted Roti wake word. His pride in noble and the unresponsive ring pay off his priorities rather than making him only Neet’s commentator.

Vacuum commute, perimeter adjustment and paw belonging to a less disciplined officer give distinct forms of Neet’s dramatic self-protection. The trade remains gradual through the third session; learning has visible attempts and consequences.
Heather’s quiet-sit request to Sagar reverses the dog-training relationship with a clean short beat. The camera lowering after the photograph gives her a separate affectionate reaction.

The episodic ten-section structure moves from useful help through exploitation attempts and learned limits to shared attention. The shut-door bell solution is causally legible; Sage does not magically solve everything.
The noble-snack callback occurs before the home question, leaving the softened Neet, perfect foot and mentor epilogue room to land warmly. No illustration crowds or preempts that ending.
